name: Card Payment Validation
definition: Results and parameters of the card payment verification.

TransactionSuccess.name: Transaction Success
TransactionSuccess.definition: Outcome of the transaction at the acceptor.

MerchantOverride.name: Merchant Override
MerchantOverride.definition: Indicate that the acceptor has forced the transaction in spite of the authorisation result (online or offline), or incident to complete the transaction.

ValidityDate.name: Validity Date
ValidityDate.definition: Transaction authorisation deadline to complete the related payment.

AuthorisationCode.name: Authorisation Code
AuthorisationCode.definition: Value assigned by the authorising party.

OnLineReason.name: On Line Reason
OnLineReason.definition: Reason to process an online authorisation.

CardholderAddressVerificationResult.name: Cardholder Address Verification Result
CardholderAddressVerificationResult.definition: Result of the cardholder verification address checks on the street number and the postal code.

CSCResult.name: CSC Result
CSCResult.definition: Result of the printed CSC (Card Security Code) validation.

ElectronicCommerceAuthenticationResult.name: Electronic Commerce Authentication Result
ElectronicCommerceAuthenticationResult.definition: Result of an e-commerce authentication process.

CardPayment.name: Card Payment
CardPayment.definition: Card payment to which the validation process applies.

Balance.name: Balance
Balance.definition: Balance of the account attached to the payment card.

DeclinedProductCode.name: Declined Product Code
DeclinedProductCode.definition: Product code for which the payment authorisation was declined.

Signature.name: Signature
Signature.definition: Signature of the message to display or print.
